==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
{{Needed|[[Pot of flour]]}}
{{Checklist|*Speak to [[Gordon]] south of the [[Farming Guild]]. {{Chat option|1Need a hand with anything?|1Yes.}}
*Speak to [[Mary_(Getting_Ahead)|Mary]] inside the main building west of Gordon.

===Tracking down the beast===
{{Needed|Combat equipment}}
*Use a [[pot of flour]] on the southern gate next to the cow pen east of Gordon.
*Follow the trail of flour south past the bridge then west to the cave at the [[Kebos Lowlands mine]].
*Kill the [[Headless Beast]].
**''Optional'': Mine some [[clay]] in the mine and pick up two [[plank]]s just to the west while you're here.
*Go back and speak to [[Gordon]].

===Making the fake head===
{{Needed|[[Soft clay]], [[knife]], [[bear fur]], [[needle]], [[thread]], [[red dye]], [[hammer]], [[saw]], two [[plank]]s, six nails of any kind}}
*Speak to [[Gordon]].
*Speak to [[Mary_(Getting_Ahead)|Mary]].
*Make a [[clay head]] by using a [[knife]] on the [[soft clay]]. {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
*Speak to [[Gordon]].
*Make a [[fur head]] by using [[bear fur]] or [[grey wolf fur]] on the head while having a [[needle]] and [[thread]]. {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
*Speak to [[Gordon]] again.
*Make a [[bloody head]] by using [[red dye]] on the head. {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
*Speak to [[Gordon]] again.
*Mount the bloody head in the Mounted Head Space on the wall south of the stairs using two planks and six nails.
*Speak to [[Gordon]] one more time.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
